description: Traffic Management — Signal locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Location of traffic signals in the Brisbane City Council area. Not all signals within Brisbane are operated by Brisbane City Council. This dataset contains only the Brisbane City Council operated signals. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are arcgis, roads traffic and parking, spatial data, crossing, intersection, lights. The portal shows 1,020 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
